title: Wi-Tek WI-AP218AX-Lite (V2) Wi-Fi 6 1757M Dual Band Indoor Ceiling Access Point

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Wi-Tek WI-AP218AX-Lite (V2) is a high-performance indoor Wi-Fi 6 access point designed for enterprise and SMB environments. With dual-band throughput up to 1757Mbps, it ensures fast, reliable wireless connectivity for high-density user scenarios. Its ceiling-mount design blends seamlessly into office and commercial spaces while delivering efficient multi-device support, advanced security, and stable wireless performance.


Key Features


  • Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) with maximum 1757Mbps throughput
  • Powerful OFDMA and MU-MIMO multi-user performance
  • Ceiling mount design ideal for offices, schools, and retail
  • Advanced WPA3 wireless security
  • Seamless roaming support for smoother transitions
  • Efficient spectrum usage for dense environments
  • Easy deployment and management
